sentences.text:
The above Writ Petition (Crl.) is filed seeking the following reliefs:
"I. Issue a Writ of Mandamus, or any other Writ, directions or Order, commanding the respondents 5 to 7 to constitute a Special Team to investigate the offences committed by the 1st respondent.
II. Declare that, respondents 5 to 7 are liable to constitute a Special Team to investigate the offences committed by the 1st respondent.
III. To dispense with translation of Malayalam documents.

IV. Issue such other order or direction as deem fit and necessary by this Hon'ble court" [SIC]
2.

It is alleged that the accused who is the 1st respondent herein introduced himself as proprietor of a business firm engaged in the supply of Church articles under the name Sanjoe City, Suppliers of Church Articles, situated at Padivattom, Ernakulam and offered the 1st petitioner a share of profit if he invested in the business.
Relying on this representation, the 2025:KER:66541 complainant invested a total amount of Rs.5,15,000/- on various occasions between 08.11.2024 and 10.12.2024.
However, the 1st respondent neither returned the invested amount nor paid the promised profit.
Hence, it is alleged that the accused committed cheating.
The grievance of the petitioner is that the investigation now conducted is not in a proper manner.

3. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor.
4.

The Public Prosecutor submitted that a statement is filed by the Additional Superintendent of Police (ASP), Ernakulam (Rural) District in which it is submitted that three cases are registered at Muvattupuzha, Oonnukal and Piravom Police Stations inter alia under Section 420 IPC.
The Public Prosecutor submitted that the investigation is going on.
The counsel for the petitioners submitted that the investigation is not going in a proper manner.
5. This Court perused the statement filed by the ASP, Ernakulam (Rural).

After going through the statement and also 2025:KER:66541 considering that three cases are registered, the ASP,
Ernakulam (Rural) should supervise all these cases and see that the investigation is conducted in a proper manner.

Therefore, this Writ Petition (Crl.) is disposed of with the following directions:
1. The 7th respondent is directed to depute Additional Superintendent of Police,
Ernakulam (Rural) District to supervise the investigation in Crime No.1432/2025 of Muvattupuzha Police Station, Crime No.498/2025 of Oonnukal Police Station and the complaint filed before the Piravom Police.
2. Necessary orders shall be passed by the 7 th respondent, within a period of two weeks from the date of receipt of certified copy of this judgment.
